box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Company name / registration number / tax reference
box_mappings.HMRC rule / legislation: Companies House record; HMRC CT notice to deliver
box_mappings.Engine validation: Exact match to CH and HMRC record

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Type of company
box_mappings.Computation logic: Usually 0 (trading/investment co); others for specified types

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Period from / Period to
box_mappings.Computation logic: CT accounting period max 12 months; accounts > 12m ⇒ 2 CT periods (first 12m + remainder) and time-apportion profits; CA computed per CT period
box_mappings.HMRC rule / legislation: CTA 2009 s9-s12; Company Tax Return guide
box_mappings.Engine validation: If accounts > 12 months: create 2 returns; Box 50 = X

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Repayment due / claim affecting earlier period / more than one return / estimated figures
box_mappings.Computation logic: Box 45 for loss carry-back claims; Box 55 only if figures genuinely estimated
box_mappings.Engine validation: Box 45 ticked when Box 275 loss carried back

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): SME exemption (transfer pricing) / accounts & computations attached
box_mappings.Computation logic: Accounts and computation must be attached in iXBRL
box_mappings.HMRC rule / legislation: Company Tax Return guide; FA 2004 iXBRL rules

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Total turnover from trade
box_mappings.Computation logic: Equals accounts turnover
box_mappings.Engine validation: Box 145 = accounts turnover exactly; compare to VAT box 6 (A-VAT-01)

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Trading profits
box_mappings.FRS 102: Accounts profit is the start point
box_mappings.Computation logic: Tax_Comp: PBT + add-backs − non-trade income − deductions − capital allowances (if positive)

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Trading losses b/f set against trading profits / Net trading profits
box_mappings.Computation logic: Losses b/f from loss memo (pre-Apr-2017 losses: same trade only)
box_mappings.Engine validation: Loss memo b/f = prior CT600 c/f (Box 285)

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Bank/building society interest and non-trading loan relationship profits
box_mappings.Computation logic: Non-trade credits less non-trade debits; deficit → 260/263
box_mappings.Engine validation: Equal to computation; deficit not entered here

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Non-exempt dividends from non-UK companies
box_mappings.Computation logic: Most dividends exempt under Part 9A; non-exempt only here

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Property business income
box_mappings.Computation logic: Property business profit (accruals basis); FV gains on investment property are NOT property income (chargeable gains rules on disposal)
box_mappings.Engine validation: Remove FV gains/losses (FRS 102 s16) in Tax_Comp

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Non-trading gains on intangible assets
box_mappings.Computation logic: CTA 2009 Part 8 (post-2002 intangibles)

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Income not elsewhere classified
box_mappings.Computation logic: Only income not taxed elsewhere; grants are usually trading receipts (Box 155)

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Gross chargeable gains / allowable losses / net chargeable gains
box_mappings.Computation logic: Gain = proceeds − cost − indexation (frozen at Dec 2017); remove the accounting profit in Tax_Comp
box_mappings.Engine validation: Accounting profit on disposal removed in comp

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Profits before other deductions and reliefs
Management expenses / UK property losses / non-trade deficits (current, b/f)
box_mappings.Computation logic: Investment companies; property losses c/f against total profits

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Total trading losses (current, carried back) / carry-back from later periods / trading losses c/f
box_mappings.Computation logic: Current-year loss vs total profits (s37(3)(a)); carry back 12 months (s37(3)(b)); else c/f (s45A)
box_mappings.HMRC rule / legislation: CTA 2010 s37, s45A; claim within 2 years
box_mappings.Engine validation: Loss memo reconciles b/f + arising − used = c/f

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Profits before donations & group relief / qualifying donations / group relief / group relief c/f losses / PROFITS CHARGEABLE TO CT
box_mappings.Computation logic: Donations added back in trading comp and deducted here (Box 305)

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Associated companies (period / FY1 / FY2) / small profits rate or MR indicator
box_mappings.Computation logic: Associated = control test (incl. via connected persons where substantial commercial interdependence); limits divided by (n+1)
box_mappings.Engine validation: Count agrees to associated companies schedule

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Tax calculation by FY / CT chargeable / marginal relief / CT
box_mappings.Accounts statement / area: P&L: tax charge; BS: CT creditor
box_mappings.Computation logic: Rate by financial year; MR = 3/200 × (U − A) × N/A
box_mappings.Engine validation: Accounts current tax = Box 440 ± prior-year adjustments

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Double taxation relief
box_mappings.Computation logic: Credit limited to UK CT on that income

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Coronavirus support received / overpayments
box_mappings.Computation logic: Taxable as trading income

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Tax on loans to participators / CT600A attached
box_mappings.Accounts line / note: Debtors – directors' loan; s455 tax shown as a debtor/charge
box_mappings.Computation logic: From CT600A A80; s455 is repayable 9 months after the end of the period in which the loan is repaid
box_mappings.Engine validation: A80 = Box 480; Box 485 = X if CT600A completed

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Bank surcharge payable
box_mappings.Computation logic: 3% above £100m allowance (banks only)

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Total tax chargeable / income tax deducted / self-assessment of tax payable
box_mappings.Engine validation: Box 528 ties to tax charge in accounts

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): R&D credit (merged RDEC) / total credits
box_mappings.Accounts statement / area: P&L: other income (RDEC above the line)
box_mappings.Computation logic: Merged RDEC 20% (taxable); notional tax deduction per CT600L

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Tax already paid / tax outstanding / tax overpaid
box_mappings.Computation logic: Payments on account (large companies: quarterly instalments)

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Franked investment income / exempt ABGH distributions
box_mappings.Computation logic: Information only; counts in augmented profits for MR (non-group dividends)

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): 51% group companies / large & very large company instalment indicators
box_mappings.Computation logic: Large if profits > £1.5m ÷ (51% group cos + 1)

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Intangibles written down/sold indicator / cross-border royalties
box_mappings.Computation logic: Amortisation of post-2002 intangibles follows accounts (Part 8); goodwill restrictions

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): R&D / creatives claim indicators & expenditure
box_mappings.Computation logic: Notification (where required) and additional information form submitted BEFORE the CT600

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Capital allowances: AIA, FYAs (incl. full expensing, 50% SR, 40% main from 1 Jan 2026), main pool (14% from 1 Apr 2026), special rate (6%), SBA (3%), balancing charges, disposal values
box_mappings.Computation logic: Depreciation added back; CAs deducted (Tax_Comp)
box_mappings.Engine validation: Additions per CA comp = FA note additions (less non-qualifying)

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Qualifying expenditure / excess amounts: losses, deficits, management expenses arising
box_mappings.Computation logic: Losses arising in the period

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): Repayments (CT, income tax, payable credits) / surrender to group
Bank details / payment authority / declaration
box_mappings.Computation logic: Director/authorised person declares

box_mappings.Official label (CT600 2026 v3): CIS suffered by a limited company subcontractor
box_mappings.Computation logic: Offset against PAYE/NIC via EPS; excess reclaimed from HMRC

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Accounts period > 12 months or < 12 months
queries.Expected State (industry norm): CT period ≤ 12 months; long period split
queries.Query to Client: The accounts cover [n] months. Two CT returns will be needed (first 12 months and the remainder). Please confirm the period dates.
queries.Evidence Required: Accounts period, CH change of ARD

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Directors/shareholders hold other companies (CH search) OR related-party transactions
queries.Expected State (industry norm): Associated companies counted for rate limits
queries.Query to Client: Please list all companies controlled by the shareholders/directors (and their close family) during the period, and whether they traded.

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Taxable profits > £1.5m ÷ (51% group cos + 1) in current or prior period
queries.Query to Client: Profits may exceed the large-company threshold. Please confirm the instalment payments made to HMRC.

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Entertaining, gifts, fines, donations, legal costs on capital items present
queries.Query to Client: Please confirm whether the following costs relate to staff or to clients/suppliers: [list].

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Accrued bonuses/directors' remuneration at YE
queries.Expected State (industry norm): Deductible only if paid within 9 months of YE
queries.Query to Client: Accrued remuneration of £[x] at year end. Please confirm when it was (or will be) paid through payroll.

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Provisions in TB
queries.Query to Client: Please explain the basis of each provision so its tax treatment can be decided.

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Employer pension accruals or large one-off director contributions
queries.Expected State (industry norm): Relief when paid; spreading for large increases
queries.Query to Client: Please confirm employer pension contributions paid in the period and any large one-off contributions.

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: FA additions per accounts
queries.Expected State (industry norm): Additions analysed into AIA / FYA (full expensing, 50% SR, 40% main) / main / special / SBA / cars by CO2
queries.Query to Client: Please provide invoices for fixed asset additions, and for vehicles the CO2 emissions and whether new or used.

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: FA disposals per accounts
queries.Query to Client: Please confirm sale proceeds for assets disposed of, and whether full expensing or AIA had been claimed on them.
queries.Tax / VAT / HMRC Ref: CAA 2001 s61; full expensing disposal rules

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Opening CA pools differ from prior-year computation
queries.Query to Client: Please provide the prior-year capital allowances computation.

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Losses b/f per PY CT600 Box 285 vs HMRC record
queries.Query to Client: Please provide the prior-year CT600 and computation showing losses carried forward.

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Current-year trading loss
queries.Query to Client: The company has a trading loss of £[x]. Please confirm whether you wish to carry it back against the prior year's profits (refund) or carry it forward.

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Charitable donations
queries.Expected State (industry norm): Qualifying charitable donations relieved in Box 305
queries.Query to Client: Please confirm the recipient charities (registered) and that no benefit was received in return.

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Overdrawn DLA at YE
queries.Query to Client: Please confirm repayments of the director's loan after year end (dates, amounts and source of funds, e.g. salary, dividend, cash).

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Repayment ≥ £5,000 and new borrowing ≥ £5,000 within 30 days; or balance ≥ £15,000 with arrangement to redraw
queries.Query to Client: A repayment of £[x] on [date] was followed by new drawings of £[y] within 30 days. Please explain the transactions.

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: DLA written off / released
queries.Expected State (industry norm): Release taxed on director (dividend income); Class 1 NIC risk; no CT deduction
queries.Query to Client: Please confirm whether any director's loan was formally released or written off, and provide the board minute.
queries.Tax / VAT / HMRC Ref: ITTOIA 2005 s415; CTA 2010 s458; CTA 2009 s321A

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: R&D claimed or development costs present
queries.Expected State (industry norm): Merged RDEC / ERIS; notification & AIF filed before CT600
queries.Query to Client: Please confirm whether R&D relief is being claimed, whether a claim notification was required/filed, and provide the additional information form.

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: 75% group with losses in a member
queries.Query to Client: Please confirm group structure and any losses to be surrendered or claimed between group companies.

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Royalties paid to non-UK persons
queries.Expected State (industry norm): WHT at 20% unless treaty rate; CT61 filed
queries.Query to Client: Royalties paid to overseas recipients were identified. Please confirm withholding tax deducted and treaty claims.

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Investments in non-UK subsidiaries or overseas branch
queries.Query to Client: Please provide details of overseas subsidiaries/branches and their profits and tax paid.

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Unusual schemes, loan arrangements, contractor loan schemes
queries.Query to Client: Has the company used any arrangement for which it received a scheme reference number?

queries.Trigger / Detection Logic: Fixed assets' book value above their tax value (accelerated capital allowances)
queries.Expected State (industry norm): Deferred tax provided or the reason it is not recorded
queries.Evidence Required: Capital allowance pools, fixed asset register
queries.Engineer Notes: Point with the worked figure, no journal: 1 of 53 final WPs with fixed assets provides it
